text:
alana: Heads up — APAC interco vendor (CloudTower Pty) rebilled late for March usage. Invoice posted 2025-04-02 but service period is 2025-03-01 to 2025-03-31. Amount AUD 62,500. Do we defer revenue or accrue for March close?
kevin: Can you drop the invoice snippet and vendor contract reference? need to size accrual. also which GL should we hit for the accrual JE?
alana: attaching snippet below — contract ref CT-SVC-2024 (billing clause allows 30d lag).
```
Invoice: CT-2025-0045
Service period: 2025-03-01 to 2025-03-31
Invoice date: 2025-04-02
Amount: AUD 62,500 (GST excl)
Vendor FX on invoice: 0.66 USD/AUD
```
jen: quick note — per revenue policy, revenue is based on when service was delivered. If service delivered in March we should recognize revenue in March. The vendor cost posting lag shouldn't delay revenue recognition.
tom: Agree with Jen. Operationally we should: 1) recognize revenue for March (if customer entitlement exists), 2) book an accrual for the vendor cost in March so COGS matches revenue, then clear when invoice is posted in April.
maya: +1 but need backup calc and approvals. For accrual JE: debit COGS (6001), credit Accrued Liabilities (2105). Use month-end spot FX per policy (2025-03-31 spot = 0.67 USD/AUD) for the accrual conversion.
kevin: ok — using 0.67 gives USD accrual = 62,500 * 0.67 = 41,875 USD. We'll round to cents in the JE. Which approver? Alana to confirm.
alana: confirm — please prepare JE and upload vendor invoice + calc to month-end binder. I'll approve up to $100k. If >100k ops escalation to Maya.
rev-bot: Reminder: "Month-end binder updated: new document added by kevin (accrual calc)." :white_check_mark:
kevin: JE draft posted in binder, file name: JE_2025-03_ACCR_CT-2025-0045.xlsx. tagging maya for review.
maya: reviewed. ok to post accrual. please include contract clause copy and note that revenue remains recognized in March per performance obligations.
tom: will add a short memo to the close pack explaining vendor lag and FX choice. :thumbsup:
alana: thanks team — booking accrual now and will attach approvals. Closing action: kevin to post JE, tom to add memo, maya to sign off in binder.
kevin: done. JE posted, tagging @alana @maya.
alana: closing — resolved for March close. :heavy_check_mark:
